Hi, I’m Wasilah.

I’m Wasilah, a Sociology graduate with experience across social media marketing, events and project coordination, and community engagement.
I enjoy turning ideas into well-organised, well-executed experiences. Whether I’m coordinating a team, planning an event, managing a campaign, or bringing an audience together, I’m at my best when there’s something to build and people to bring along.

SERVICES

Digital Marketing 

Social Media

Project cordination

Event Planning

Stakeholder Coordination

Customer & Sales Support

Hi, I’m Wasilah.

I’m Wasilah, a Sociology graduate with experience across social media marketing, events and project coordination, and community engagement.
I enjoy turning ideas into well-organised, well-executed experiences. Whether I’m coordinating a team, planning an event, managing a campaign, or bringing an audience together, I’m at my best when there’s something to build and people to bring along.

CHALLENGE

Halden came to the studio with a strong product and a crowded shelf. The brief: stand out without shouting, and build a system that scales from a single launch to a full range.

We started with research on shelf, on screen and in conversation — then reduced everything to one idea the whole team could repeat in a sentence.

IDENTITY

RESULTS

Launched in 2026. In the first quarter: +38% sell-through, 12→140 stores, 2.1× recall.

CHALLENGE

Kiln & Co came to the studio with a strong product and a crowded shelf. The brief: stand out without shouting, and build a system that scales from a single launch to a full range.

We started with research on shelf, on screen and in conversation — then reduced everything to one idea the whole team could repeat in a sentence.

We started with research on shelf, on screen and in conversation — then reduced everything to one idea the whole team could repeat in a sentence.

CHALLENGE

Orbit came to the studio with a strong product and a crowded shelf. The brief: stand out without shouting, and build a system that scales from a single launch to a full range.

We started with research on shelf, on screen and in conversation — then reduced everything to one idea the whole team could repeat in a sentence.
